text.tspan: On the other side of the phone, you
hear faint static. You say “Hello?” and
hear “Hello. Are you trapped in Test
say “I think so”. “Well, I will send help
to get you out of there. I was in there
too for a while, and I didn’t know what
to do but play solitaire. Don’t worry, you’ll
get out of there soon.” 25 minutes later,
a help van arrives, smashes the window,
